note: R7-X: what reaches the axis pointer's line and band, the component boxes, a candlestick (its top-level keys) and a bar's corners. Each case settled (its action dispatched and settled); `pens` the sorted set of stroke|width|dash|offset|cap/join/miter of every stroked path of the part ('' the series' views; pointer the axes' pointer groups, each entry prefixed with its axis; title / legend / toolbox / visualMap the component's background rect), as root-styles.js; nocolour: the pens without the stroke colour; `looks` opacity|shadowBlur|shadowOffsetX|shadowOffsetY|shadowColor; `fills`; `shapes` rects and sectors with their corners; `texts` the component's texts; `icons` a legend's icon symbol types; `vm` the visualMap model's itemSize and text; `tip` (part tooltip) the item tooltip model's formatter, borderColor, padding, order, backgroundColor and borderRadius as showTip builds it, and its rich-text box's text and border colour; `labels` the text|fill of each series element's label; part geo every path of the geo component's view; `polys` a component's polygons (root-styles.js'). `maps` the maps registered.
